properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 9 at 9:07AM CST until November 9 at 3:00PM CST by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Kimble County in west central Texas...
Western Mason County in west central Texas...
Southeastern Menard County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 300 PM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. Some low-water crossings may become
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 901 AM CST, the public reported heavy rain in low water
crossings. This will cause small stream flooding. Between 2.5 and
3.5 inches of rain have fallen over the past 2-3 days.
- Low water crossings are the most likely place to experience minor
flooding. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
South Llano River State Park, US-377 near Telegraph, Ranch Road
2291 north of I-10, Ranch Road 385 from US-377 to US-290, Farm to
Market 2169 near Junction, The Intersection Of Us-83 And Ranch
Road 1773, and Us-83 Near The Kerr-Kimble County Line
- This includes Interstate 10 between Mile Markers 435 and 477.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 9 at 4:44AM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
A strong system is expected to move through the area Monday.
Temperatures below freezing combined with snow levels below 1,000 ft
are indicative of snowfall for upper elevations. Mid-level
southeasterly flow suggests potential for White Pass to be sheltered
from much of the precipitation, but would allow for ample moisture to
make it into the Haines Borough, falling as snow at the border along
the Haines Highway.

* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 4 to 6 inches
possible.

* WHERE...The Klondike Highway, near White Pass.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Possibility for reduced visibilities due to blowing snow.
Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds gusting up to 25 mph may cause blowing
snow and reduce visibilities.
properties.instruction:

conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.
